_comment: LAY-001: When an article references an image URL that returns 404 or is unreachable, the renderer MUST leave a visible placeholder with an annotation describing what was expected — NOT attempt LLM-based image generation, NOT silently drop the element, and NOT substitute a generic thumbnail.

scenario.description: Article includes an tag whose src resolves to HTTP 404. The layout renderer should detect the broken reference and inject a placeholder block with a human-readable annotation.
